entries.bindingRationale: Non-Nim medium (.github/workflows/runner-pool-acceptance.yml): a Nim {.axiomDebt.} pragma is structurally impossible for a workflow YAML surface, so the registry entry itself is the binding medium. Trace: this entry's resolution=UNRESOLVED and source=storage-retention-workstream-G1-upload-inventory-2026-10-10; external: docs/spec/github_artifact_attempt_quirks.md:33-36 and docs/adr/0033-sl02-consumer-binding.md:104-107.
entries.description: actions/upload-artifact@v4 artifacts are immutable and name-unique per run: without `overwrite: true`, an upload whose name already exists in the run is documented to fail (vendor README `overwrite` input — default false, "If false, the action will fail if an artifact for the given name already exists", https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/blob/main/README.md; MIGRATION.md — "In v4, Artifacts are immutable unless deleted", `overwrite: true` deletes the matching artifact before creating the new one, https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/blob/main/docs/MIGRATION.md). Without `overwrite`, a re-run (run_attempt > 1) of the producing job collides on the same name, and the repo's own live measurement shows the platform behaves NONDETERMINISTICALLY on that collision — attempt 1's copy replaced (later 404) in run 37176994649 but coexisting (2 live artifacts) in run 37183851918 — with the observed failure mode being the consumer-side exactly-one check "found 2 (fail-closed)", not an upload-side 409 (docs/spec/github_artifact_attempt_quirks.md:6-36; docs/evidence/org_gate_handoff_2026-10-04.md §5.1). Affected sites — both LACK `overwrite` (lines on branch feat/storage-retention-policy @ 4554c48f3, i.e. post-PR-#710 numbering; pre-#710 numbers in parens): .github/workflows/runner-pool-acceptance.yml:769-773 `candidate-arm64` (retention-days: 3 at :773; :723 pre-#710) — fail-closed same-run consumer at :875-882 (shard downloads it, compile=0, per-file sha256 binding), so a re-run collision turns a legitimate re-run of the gateway lane red; .github/workflows/runner-pool-acceptance.yml:665-681 `ci-bootstrap-artifacts` (retention-days: 3 at :670; :642 pre-#710) — fail-open cross-run consumer (ci-cache-publisher.yml:199-207 existence guard publishing [publish-skip] on absence, :264-274 cross-run download with run-id github.event.workflow_run.id). Severity held at medium, not high: the collision class is proven (vendor docs + repo quirk record), but the specific upload-side 409 was never observed in this repo and one of the two consumers is fail-open. Remedy, per the repo's own policy "For non-evidence payloads (cache seeding), a stable name plus `overwrite: true` is the explicit, deterministic option" (docs/spec/github_artifact_attempt_quirks.md:33-36): add `overwrite: true` to the non-evidence upload ci-bootstrap-artifacts (its consumer is the cache publisher — cache is acceleration, not evidence); for candidate-arm64 the alternatives are `overwrite: true` (self-consistent on re-run because the shard re-verifies the producer manifest sha256) or a `run_attempt`-suffixed name (evidence-artifact convention, same spec :33-34) — the choice belongs to the producer-DAG owner and is deliberately NOT taken by this registration. The two admission-check hot-path sites already carry the sanctioned form (overwrite: true at admission-check.yml:543 and :589, branch feat/storage-retention-policy @ 4554c48f3). OUT OF SCOPE of PR #710 per AGENTS.md §2.2 (범위는 닫힌다 / 발견 ≠ 권한) and docs/adr/0033-sl02-consumer-binding.md:104-107 ((g) bypass 재사용 금지 — producer DAG incl. `overwrite`/deletion paths is org-side producer scope). Registered by the storage-retention bookkeeping slice (G1 upload-site inventory, docs/evidence/artifact_upload_inventory_2026-10-10.json).

entries.title: Post-hover liveness check bare except swallow (lean_lsp_protocol.nim:295)
entries.description: Bare except: discard at lean_lsp_protocol.nim:295-296 silently swallows uncategorizable exceptions during LSP process liveness check. While CatchableError returns an error response, the catch-all discard means system-level failures (e.g., OS-level handle errors on peekExitCode) are ignored — violating AGENTS.md §0.9 Theater Signature #2. The post-hover liveness check claims to verify LSP process health but provides no evidence when unexpected errors occur. [FIXED 2026-07-30: replaced discard with stderr logging + error response]
entries.resolutionNote: Replaced bare except: discard with stderr logging via writeLine(stderr, ...) using getCurrentExceptionMsg(), and returning err("lsp-liveness-check-unexpected") for fail-closed behavior. Verified compilation with nim check.

entries.title: scribe.nim: synthesizeLeanTheorem returns ok(emptyArtifact) on ALL exceptions

entries.resolutionNote: Implemented Result[ScribeArtifact, ScribeError] return type. synthesizeLeanTheorem now returns err(ScribeError) on exception. Callers propagate err via fail-closed chain. Compilation verified with nim check.

entries.title: proofs/GateInvariants/CacheKeyCompleteness.lean uses axiom hash_injective as proof foundation
entries.description: CacheKeyCompleteness.lean:47 declares 'axiom hash_injective : ∀ a b, computeKey a = computeKey b → a = b' and derives cache_key_complete / cache_key_complete_explicit by one-line deduction from this axiom. This is circular: it asserts the very injectivity/collision-resistance that the cache-key-uniqueness theorems are meant to prove. SHA-256 collision resistance is 'believed' not proven. Presents an assumption as a verification guarantee. Additionally the Lean proof layer (lake build) is not compiled in CI, and the axiomatization would go undetected since check_lean_vacuity scans for sorry/hasSorry but not axiom declarations.
entries.resolutionNote: FIXED — CacheKeyCompleteness.lean:47 axiom hash_injective removed; injectivity reframed as explicit HashInjectivity hypothesis threaded through theorems. check_lean_vacuity extended to flag custom axioms via #print axioms (not just sorryAx); lake build + gate wired in CI.

entries.title: Parallel depth scheduler SIGSEGV: malebolgia spawn shares main-thread heap + limit-check bug inflates batch to 4890
entries.description: bin/ax prove with AXIOM_PROVE_WORKERS>1 crashes with SIGSEGV (Illegal storage access, nil read) immediately after 'deterministic-scheduler: depth=0 items=4890'. Two compounding defects in src/verification/batch_uap/loop_depth_scheduler.nim: (1) limit check at lines 344-346 compares report.nodeReports.len (never grows during the filter loop, primed not subtracted) so pendingItems accumulates all 4890 depth-0 items instead of the --limit batch; (2) fingerprint/node workers spawned via malebolgia receive SorterState, Table[string,string], and a shared ptr ParallelNodeContext — main-thread heap objects dereferenced on worker threads under --mm:arc --threads:on, violating section 0.6a (value-type only across spawn). {.cast(gcsafe).} at line 278 suppresses the Nim 2.2 isolation check that would have caught this. Serial path (workers=1) is unaffected and is now the CI default.
entries.resolutionNote: Repair plan (architect approval required): (1) fix limit check to mirror the serial path ((report.nodeReports.len - primedReportCount) >= effectiveNodeLimit with a local counter + break); (2) replace heap-sharing spawn payloads with serialized values or the proven createThread + thread-local ParallelIrContext pattern from axiom_engine.nim; (3) remove {.cast(gcsafe).} suppression once payloads are isolation-safe. Until then CI pins AXIOM_PROVE_WORKERS=1.

entries.title: .git/index influences hermetic cache identity
entries.lineRange: config.nims:442 (git:HEAD fold) and config.nims:448-457 (.git/index fold) and config.nims:465-474 (nimcache purge) — all removed 2026-10-05
entries.description: .git/index는 VCS staging state이며 compiler semantic state가 아님. 이상은 cache identity = toolchain/config/source/dependency. PREMISE CORRECTION 2026-10-05: 이전 rationale의 'config.nims 불가침 제약으로 지금 수정 않음'은 사실과 달랐다 — AGENTS.md §-1이 동결하는 것은 config.nims 파일 전체가 아니라 'config.nims importEncapsulation 블록'뿐이고 그 블록은 더 이상 파일에 존재하지 않으며(grep 0건), import_encapsulation_gate도 config.nims를 읽지 않는다. 실제 blocker는 config/repository_surface.json FROZEN + make check-repository-surface(pre-push fail-closed)였고 인간 오너 승인으로 통과했다. 실제 근본은 과잉무효화가 아니라 자가무효화 루프였다: MISS 분기의 bin/hermetic_build가 git status/git diff를 실행해 .git/index stat cache를 재작성하는데 그 해시가 envHash에 포함되어 있어 MISS가 자기 자신의 트리거를 만들었다 — 실측상 무변경 재실행이 CC 629 + purge로 측정되었다. QUIRK-DOC: docs/spec/config_nims_hermetic_cache_quirk.md (AGENTS.md §0.5 quirk list).
entries.resolutionNote: FIXED — hermetic cache identity를 빌드 입력 콘텐츠의 순수 함수로 복원하고 재컴파일 판정을 컴파일러에 반환했다. (1) config.nims에서 envHash의 git-state 항 2종 제거: `envHash &= "git:" & gitHeadRef` 와 LOCAL-only `.git/index` dirty-marker 블록. (2) 이미 존재하며 이미 매 nim c마다 호출되고 있던 computeSourceTreeHash("src") (config.nims:352)를 source 항으로 폴드 — 신규 helper 아님, 추가 filesystem 비용 0. (3) MISS 분기의 rmDir("build/nimcache") purge 제거 — Axiom이 컴파일러의 재컴파일 결정을 덮어쓰던 권한을 철회. (4) gitHeadRef 계산과 build_env.nim의 __AXIOM_GIT_HASH__ 치환은 유지되어 BuildEnvGitHash(증명 서명 identity, proof_verifier.nim:41)는 계속 live 값으로 갱신된다. MEASURED (branch fix/config-nims-envhash-content-identity, Nim 2.2.10, AXIOM_CI_PRESERVE_CACHE 미설정): 비의미 편집+git add → CC 0 / purge 0 / HIT / artifact digest 불변(변경 전은 CC 629 + purge); 소비되는 비-.nim 입력(data/i18n/ko.json의 gates.sieve.name) 변경 → 정확히 CC 1 / digest 변화 후 원복 시 CC 0 복귀; 의미적 .nim 편집 → digest 변화 후 원복 시 기준 digest 복귀. false reuse 0. RESIDUAL: 손상된 .o 재사용 위험(cgen.nim:2230 mtime 폴백)은 purge를 거친 방어를 의도적으로 포기하고 문서화함. AXIOM_CI_PRESERVE_CACHE는 config.nims에서 더 이상 reader가 없는 no-op이 되었고 그 은퇴는 후속 슬라이스 사양. src/gate/orchestrator/hook/memo.nim의 DEBT#417 마커는 §0.5c에 따라 유지하되 설명 주석만 갱신했다. 본 문서가 권위 레코드다.

entries.title: elan shim pitfall: bare PATH lean may resolve to wrong toolchain version
entries.description: QUIRK(DEBT#427): bare PATH `lean` may be an elan shim to a different toolchain (4.29) than the project-pinned kernel (4.33 via `lake env lean`). Previously executableDigest hashed the lake binary and toolchainFingerprint was a hardcoded label, so runs claiming the same execution contract could observe different axiom sets. RESOLVED (Phase 1): resolveLeanBinaryPath() resolves the real lean kernel binary (lake env which lean -> elan which lean -> dirname(findExe lake)/lean, never bare PATH lean), and computeBundleDigest() binds measured lean/lake binary content plus lean-toolchain/lake-manifest/lakefile content into toolchainFingerprint. Quirk documented in docs/spec/lean_toolchain_binding_quirks.md.
entries.resolutionNote: FIXED via measured toolchain binding (resolveLeanBinaryPath + computeBundleDigest); quirk documented.

entries.title: G4: command || echo fail-open swallow at 3 sites converts failure to success (ci.yml:217-223, ci.yml:276-278, Makefile:598)
entries.symbol: .github/workflows/ci.yml measure_coverage / nightly ax prove / Makefile lake build
entries.lineRange: historical: ci.yml:217-223,276-278 (deleted in CI epoch cutover) / Makefile:598 (rewritten fail-closed, now Makefile:1090; re-verified 2026-10-07 at Makefile:1140)
entries.description: Three sites use `command || echo` fail-open: ci.yml:217-223 (measure_coverage || echo skipped), ci.yml:276-278 (nightly bin/ax prove --limit 25 || echo '[WARN] bounded prove incomplete'), Makefile:598 (lake build || echo WARNING). GitHub Actions default run: shell injects set -e, but in `command || echo`, command is not the last element of the || list and is therefore exempt from set -e fail-fast; thus the non-zero is genuinely converted to 0. This is distinct from `if ! command; then echo FAIL; exit 1; fi` (fail-closed). Per Contract Preservation Audit 2026-08-23, G4 must be verified operationally fail-closed (intentional failure -> step non-zero -> job failure -> workflow failure propagation), not merely syntactically. ci.yml is §-1 protected; requires architect approval (4c). REF HYGIENE 2026-10-07: all three registered sites remediated or dissolved — the Makefile:598 lake build fail-open is rewritten fail-closed (now Makefile:1090 `|| { echo 'FATAL: lake build failed' ...; exit 1; }`), and the two ci.yml sites dissolved when ci.yml was deleted in the CI epoch cutover (no ci.yml exists under .github/workflows/). files[] emptied (DEBT#419 empty-files precedent); Makefile moved to historicalFiles. NOT closed: an operational fail-closed re-sweep (G4) of the current workflow generation was NOT performed in this hygiene pass and remains the open concern. CLOSURE 2026-10-07 (debt-truth reconciliation, EXTINCT): the G4 operational re-sweep of the current workflow generation WAS performed on origin/main 4805fe1df — all three registered fail-open sites remain dissolved/remediated (no ci.yml under .github/workflows/; lake build fail-closed at Makefile:1140 `(cd proofs && lake build) || { echo 'FATAL: lake build failed' ...; exit 1; }`, drifted from the :1090 recorded at hygiene time), and the full current-generation `|| echo` sweep found 4 sites, none of which converts a verification failure to success: h4-routing-measure.yml:123 (arch value-default expression), probe-merge-queue.yml:276-277 (optional merge-parent resolution with explicit empty default; verdict logic branches on emptiness — evidence probe, not a gate), Makefile:21 (toolchain path default inside $(shell)). The open concern recorded above is discharged by this measured sweep.
entries.resolutionNote: EXTINCT — all three registered fail-open sites dissolved or rewritten fail-closed, and the residual open concern (G4 operational re-sweep of the current generation) discharged by measurement on origin/main 4805fe1df: no ci.yml under .github/workflows/ (CI epoch cutover); lake build fail-closed at Makefile:1140; residual `|| echo` census (4 sites: h4-routing-measure.yml:123, probe-merge-queue.yml:276-277, Makefile:21) are value-default/optional-lookup expressions, not failure swallows — details in description CLOSURE 2026-10-07 paragraph.

entries.title: G6: no structural/behavioral test asserting product readers do not read tracked reference store; proof_hydration fallback reads reference store
entries.symbol: proof_hydration.nim StableVaultDir / product readers (verify_cli, report_cli, axiom_status, axiom_engine)
entries.description: Product readers verified: ax prove reads cvRuntimeCanonical (data/trusted/certificates, axiom_engine.nim:598); ax verify reads TrustCommit journal (verify_cli.nim:46-67); ax report/status read logs/ax_proof_state.json. BUT proof_hydration.nim:22,178 defines StableVaultDir = 'src/verification/certificates' (reference store) and uses it as a fallback read for VKD metrics -- a reference-store read path potentially used by product readers via proof hydration. No structural test asserts product readers do not read the reference store (only write-scope guard I7 and I5 no-reexec exist). Per Contract Preservation Audit 2026-08-23, fix by consumer namespace (product reader -> runtime only; engineering/VKD reader -> tracked reference allowed), not removal: 'VKD computation may read reference artifacts, but Product State may not'. Require both structural AND behavioral tests (runtime=VERIFIED, tracked=FAILED -> verify/report/status output VERIFIED).

entries.title: G7: no CI release build of bin/ax and no product E2E on the release binary
entries.description: bin/ax release binary is produced only as a transitive side effect of ci-unit-tests -> nimble build -> nim c -d:release, with no explicit build step and no job running product E2E (ax prove -> evidence -> persist -> replay) on the release binary. This leaves a path where a stale bin/ax could be used for testing. Per Contract Preservation Audit 2026-08-23, require explicit `nim c -d:release -o:bin/ax` build + same-job executable hash + product E2E on that exact binary. Note Nim doAssert is always active in release (no debug/release divergence was ever relied upon), but release E2E is still required for dev/product semantics separation. ci.yml is §-1 protected; requires architect approval (4c).

entries.title: ci-unit-tests verification commands swallowed non-zero exit via `|| rm -rf` cleanup (fail-open)
entries.description: Makefile:397-398 appended `|| rm -rf build/nimcache/release/<target>` to the verification commands (`$(NIM) c -d:release -r ... tests/test_proof_injector.nim` and `... test_vc_complete.nim`). When the Nim compile/run exited non-zero, the `|| rm -rf` fallback ran and returned 0, so `ci.yml:246` (bare `make ci-unit-tests` step) reported CI success despite verification failure - violating AGENTS.md §4 fail-closed (P-R001, source: docs/audit/ci_survey_2026-08-27.md). Root cause removed 2026-08-27: verification commands are now single-command (no cleanup suffix); exit status is the single source of truth. Regression-protected by anti_theater_gate Rule C (known-dangerous swallow tripwire) and tests/gateway/make_fail_closed_feature_test.nim.
entries.resolutionNote: Verification commands in ci-unit-tests no longer append `|| rm -rf` cleanup; exit status is the single source of truth (I-CI-FAIL-CLOSED). anti_theater_gate Rule C extended to known-dangerous swallow patterns (`|| rm|echo|true|:`) and GitHub Actions scope as regression tripwire; make_fail_closed feature test asserts non-zero propagation, legacy-swallow behavior, and a static anchor on the Makefile.

entries.title: ax debt mutation path 부재 — registry change와 P1 projection materialization이 별개 수동 작업
entries.description: DEBT#436 사건의 근본 원인: SSOT(data/debt_registry.json) 변경과 derived-state materialization(docs/DEBT_REGISTRY.md, src/generated/debt_constants.nim)이 별개의 수동 작업이라 재현 가능. 현재 변경 경로는 'registry를 사람이 직접 편집 → 개발자가 codegen 실행을 기억'이며, 기억에 의존하면 파생 파일 누락이 필연적으로 재발. 이상적 해결은 전용 mutation path(ax debt add|update|close)가 validate → mutate SSOT → generate all P1 → validate outputs → atomic materialization을 단일 원자 작업으로 수행하는 것. 이번 작업은 수동 edit → canonical codegen(bin/debt_engine --codegen) → sync-budget → validate의 mutation protocol을 확립하고 docs/spec/debt_projection_contract.md에 계약으로 명문화함. 전용 mutation command가 아직 없어 OPEN 유지(bootstrap 회피).
entries.resolution: FIXED 2026-11-13 (workstream/vs2-debt-state-integrity): atomic mutation path implemented as bin/debt_engine --close — pre-validate → mutate SSOT → P1 materialize (temp+rename) → P2 budget sync → post-validate, with byte-identical 4-file rollback on any failure (DEBT#437's ideal: validate → mutate SSOT → generate all P1 → validate outputs → atomic materialization as a single operation). Contract codified in docs/spec/debt_projection_contract.md §5.1; manual edit protocol retained as §5.2 recovery path. DEBT#437 closed via its own mechanism (dogfood).
entries.note: DEBT#436 remediation 시 원칙 확립: 모든 generated artifact는 source of truth의 pure projection이어야 하며, projection은 mutation path에서 자동 materialize되고 CI에서는 독립적으로 재생성하여 checked-in state와 byte 단위 비교(Generate(SSOT) == CheckedInProjection). P1(MD+Nim)은 --codegen의 byte-identity guard로 검증, P2(ledger current)는 --sync-budget으로 정합. GeneratorVersion=1 임베드로 결정론적 바이트 안정성 보장.
entries.resolutionNote: Equivalence proven: runValidateCore/syncBudgetCore refactored with byte-identical --validate/--sync-budget output vs pre-change baseline binary; 14/14 unit tests (9 existing + 5 atomicity cases incl. byte-identical rollback on injected post-validate failure).

entries.title: Makefile ENFORCED comment claims G5 but verify-contract recipe omits G5 target
entries.description: Makefile line 274 comment declares `# ENFORCED = G1 ∧ G2 ∧ G4 ∧ G5 ∧ G6 ∧ G7 (G3 = Engineering Guard, 여기 포함 안 함).` but the verify-contract recipe (Makefile lines 276-282) only invokes verify-contract-unit (G2), verify-invariant-mutation (G1), verify-scenario-oracles (G6·G4), verify-contract-release-e2e (G7). grep shows "G5" appears ONLY at Makefile line 274 — no G5 make target, no G5 recipe, no G5 in src/gate/manifest.d/*.json. docs/spec/productization_contract_freeze_v1.md:135 requires G5 folded into verify-contract's four buckets; .github/workflows/ci.yml:236 labels verify-contract as G1/G2/G4/G6/G7 (omits G5). entries.resolutionNote: FIXED 2026-10-07 — the unenforced-claim debt (a comment asserting enforcement that does not exist) resolved by correcting the comment to describe reality, not by adding an enforcement pretense. Makefile:536 now reads ENFORCED = G1 ∧ G2 ∧ G4 ∧ G6 ∧ G7 (G3 = Engineering Guard, G5 = 테스트 배선 미완료 — DEBT#432, 미포함). Evidence: verify-contract fan-out membership is exactly g2(verify-contract-unit)/g1(verify-invariant-mutation)/g6g4(verify-scenario-oracles)/g7(verify-contract-release-e2e) per CONTRACT_FANOUT_TARGETS; no G5 make target or recipe exists; post-fix grep of G5 in Makefile returns 0 hits. The freeze contract (docs/spec/productization_contract_freeze_v1.md §4) still requires G5 folded into verify-contract AND run under CI — that wiring gap remains DEBT#432 (open), deliberately NOT claimed resolved here. The deferred state (PR #18, 2026-08-31) existed only because patching the comment while G5 stayed unwired would have masked the gap; this closure fixes ONLY the false claim and keeps the wiring debt open under #432. contentHash retained as the historical record of the registered false claim; the corrected line no longer matches it, so the theater 0-token skip cannot falsely fire.

entries.title: Historical tcVerifiedProof records are provenance-unqualified
entries.description: The pre-WP3-b trust journal (data/trusted/journal/, observed 6,806 tcVerifiedProof records at experiment time) was produced by a writer that did not guarantee current kernel proof evidence binding at creation time. Root cause: pre-WP3-b commitVerification(currentDir) wrote tcVerifiedProof without a hard kernel-evidence gate, so a record's existence in the historical journal is not sufficient evidence that a kernel proof was actually produced when it was written. Running tally of historical solver-invocation origins: vault-manifest 6,668; proof-universe-lock:v33 84; batch-uap-loop 36; cert-promotion 18. Claim formats: entries[] 6,668; graphSnapshot 84; certificate/other 54. irHash is a one-way digest (SHA-256 over canonical IR) and the .axiom/vault CAS is empty, so ~all claims are not directly re-verifiable from the artifact alone (Track-1 Historical Reconstruction is low-certainty; Track-2 Current Re-verification is a separate question and possible). Decision: historical records must NOT be used as current verified-truth without re-verification; WP3-b gate blocks new unqualified records; this WP3-c entry registers the historical population as legacy-unverified, records an immutable inventory (experiments/act2-wp3c-historical-trust-debt/output/manifest.json, manifestDigest=a42bf17d0eaf8ef718f3514ba1d3756d9abf47239547c53c1b0089b511e99663), and defers operational reader exclusion + batch re-validation of the 6,806 records to a dedicated Debt Work Package.

entries.title: gate memo/CAS skip keys omit transitive import closure
entries.description: gate memo/CAS skip keys omit transitive import closure — the active memo-skip path (computeGateCacheKey/computeCacheKey in src/gate/orchestrator/hook/memo.nim:111-138) calls computeCompositeLockHash WITHOUT transitiveHash, and findChangedGateIds (src/cli/precompile_gates.nim:213-227) compares only each gate's own source-file hash. Additionally gate_cas.nim overloads empty string with 6+ distinct meanings (missing file :24, fallback :35-42, insufficient inputs :54, CAS miss :88/:102/:130, not-found/error :300/:318), conflating 'normal miss' (A) with 'key uncomputable' (B); the contract requires typed resolution, not an empty-string sentinel. entries.title: fcUnknown FAIL verdict silently cached and reused (fail-open)

This is a silent fail-open theater: an unclassifiable failure is treated as a stable cached verdict. entries.title: verify-contract parallel launcher fail-open on lost evidence
entries.description: make verify-contract (pre-fix Makefile:371-388) parallel launcher backgrounds 4 subtarget shells with '&' while 'rm -rf && mkdir -p .verify-contract-logs' itself runs inside the FIRST backgrounded job, so g1/g6g4/g7 subshells can start before the log dir exists -> pid/log/status redirects fail ('No such file or directory'). The report loop then reads a missing status file into an empty var, '[ "" -ne 0 ]' errors to false -> prints [PASS] without evidence (fail-open / swallowed failure). Observed in PR #37 CI run 33879762070 (2026-09-04): '[PASS] g6g4' and '[PASS] g7' printed alongside 'cat: .verify-contract-logs/g6g4.status: No such file or directory'; g1.log evidence also lost. Fix (PR #38): mkdir -p moved to its own foreground recipe line before any backgrounding + report loop now treats a missing status file as [FAIL]. make verify-contract re-verified green locally.

verify-contract parallel subtargets collide on shared generated binaries: g2 (verify-contract-unit) and g6g4 (verify-scenario-oracles) both invoke `nim c tools/sync_certs.nim --ensure` via config/integrity.nims:156 into the SAME content-hashed output path bin/sync_certs_<hash>, so concurrent compiles produce 'sh: ...sync_certs_1C3599EF...: Text file busy' (ETXTBSY); g7 (verify-contract-release-e2e) hit the same class on bin/feature_manifest_generator_<hash>: Permission denied. Probabilistic race on the 2-vCPU CI runner (rerun of PR #38 CI run passed). Observed 2026-09-05 in PR #38 CI run 33928966693; previously masked by the fail-open [PASS] on lost status files (DEBT#456, now fixed - failures are visible). Fixed in PR #39 (build once -> freeze -> fan-out): new serial make prerequisite verify-contract-artifacts materializes bin/sync_certs and bin/feature_manifest_generator (stable --out names, usenimcache hash suffix dropped for these two tools) exactly once before fan-out; config/integrity.nims hooks now execute the frozen binaries read-only under AXIOM_VERIFY_CONTRACT_FANOUT=1 (fail-closed when missing) instead of recompiling, structurally removing the parallel write edge. Invariants: no shared-artifact compile in the parallel phase; artifacts exist before fan-out; read-only after fan-out; scheduling-independent evidence. g1 excluded from the guard (isolated purity_check worktree, serial within itself).

canonical execution aggregation defect — multi-wave runs overwrite per-wave reports (last wave wins): the wave-loop body assigns proofReport per wave and the post-loop merge at axiom_engine.nim:1049-1059 copies the FINAL wave's summary/nodeReports/executionStats into reportJson (the wave loop itself never accumulates), so non-final-wave nodeReports and per-wave executionStats are lost from the merged report (wavesExecuted>1 runs report only the last wave). WaveResult* → RunResult append-only accumulator + runOutcome emission required (forward structure). Downstream: execution accounting cannot be computed from the merged report alone; X1.0 compensates by re-reading per-wave reports from the trajectory log (measurementCompensated=true, compensationSource=trajectory).
entries.note: Related telemetry defect (same aggregation axis): obligationAttemptedCount is obligation-WEIGHTED — loop_driver.nim:934 adds the node's whole obligationCount rather than counting units — and the parallel path never increments it; additionally the accounting reducers must NOT use obligationAttemptedCount as freshExecutionCount (see docs/spec/execution_accounting_contract.md §3).
entries.resolutionNote: Canonical boundary installed (Phase X1): CanonicalRunResult is now the authoritative execution source; the wave loop ACCUMULATES per-wave reports and dispatched-unit sets; the legacy report (renderLegacyReport), the state file (renderPersist) and the TrustCommit projection (UniverseIntegrityProjection) are pure projections of (CanonicalRunResult, PreRunContext); the last-wave document is never a data source. See docs/spec/execution_accounting_contract.md.

entries.title: parallel cache-hit evidence omission — per-unit REUSED not attributable in parallel runs
entries.description: parallel cache-hit evidence omission — cache-hit rows are emitted with status=failed and the row's own cacheHit field never set, so per-unit REUSED is not attributable in parallel runs; blocks X2 parallel-execution economics. The cache-hit branch in processOneNodeParallelBody (loop_depth_scheduler.nim:151-165) sets res.cacheHit=true on the ParallelNodeResult but the emitted OrchestrationNodeReport carries status=orchestrationProofFailed and cacheHit=false (default), so the canonical accounting cannot distinguish REUSED satisfaction from a genuine failed verdict on the parallel path.
entries.note: X2 entry condition = this resolved. With DEBT#458 closed, canonical run accounting is production-native; per-unit REUSED attribution on the parallel path is the remaining X2 economics blocker.
entries.resolutionNote: Parallel cache-hit evidence attribution fixed: the emitted OrchestrationNodeReport now carries cacheHit=true (loop_depth_scheduler.nim cache-hit branch); the canonical reducer (run_accounting.nim) classifies the (status, cacheHit=true) pair as REUSED — VerificationOutcome=SATISFIED, SatisfactionSource=REUSED, ExecutionEvidence=NOT_ATTEMPTED, never invocation-witnessed — matching the serial path's cache-hit semantics (loop_driver stage-1d reuse = satisfaction without fresh execution). Genuine failures (cacheHit=false) remain UNSATISFIED + witnessed; the fail-closed runtime status (orchestrationProofFailed — cache hit ≠ kernel acceptance, C0.4 hardening) is unchanged. Ripples documented in docs/spec/execution_accounting_contract.md §15: cache-hit rows no longer inflate report summary failedCount/statusCounts (counted as reused; exit-code path), attemptedUnits excludes them (executionComplete=false for warm reuse-only runs), executedCount = attemptedCount + reused rows.

entries.description: gate-telemetry upload silently shipped an EMPTY artifact: the 'Upload gate telemetry' step (upload-artifact@v4) uploaded .axiom/gate_history.jsonl, but v4 excludes hidden/dotfiles by default, so the artifact contained nothing — the step appeared to preserve gate telemetry while shipping nothing (theater per AGENTS.md §0.9). FIXED 2026-09-07 in the CI DAG redesign by adding include-hidden-files: true to the step.

entries.title: pr_coverage_commenter silent no-op: no CI producer for build/branch_coverage.json
entries.description: tools/pr_coverage_commenter.nim:505-512 reads build/branch_coverage.json and, when it is missing, WARNs and quit(0)s. The pr-coverage-comment CI job (PR-only, .github/workflows/ci.yml:414-432) has NO producer for build/branch_coverage.json and downloads no artifact, so on ephemeral CI runners the comment job is a silent no-op that appears to guarantee PR coverage feedback while guaranteeing nothing (theater per AGENTS.md §0.9). Registered finding only — tool unchanged; fix deferred (requires a coverage producer + artifact download wiring in the pr-coverage-comment job). FIXED 2026-09-07 (DEBT#461 fix): coverage dataflow restored — (1) producer wiring: verify-coverage-guard emits build/branch_coverage.json via build_metrics --emit-branch-coverage (new explicit flag; format already matched loadHeadSnapshot) and uploads it as artifact coverage-head-snapshot (if-no-files-found: error, retention-days: 7); (2) needs edge: pr-coverage-comment gains needs: [verify-coverage-guard] + actions/download-artifact@v4 (path build/) before the commenter — the workflow's single justified artifact read-after-write edge, contract-gated in config/ci_dag_contract.json allowedNeedsEdges; (3) fail-closed conversion: missing-snapshot path changed WARN+quit(0) → WARN+quit(1) (defense in depth — the needs gate + download hard-fail already guarantee the artifact upstream). Note: build_metrics coverage numbers remain heuristic estimates (0.85/0.05 multipliers, no instrumentation); deltas are consistent like-with-like via the same estimator.

entries.description: Canonical merge landing is not causally coupled to certificate issuance and ledger advancement. In the Model B flow, main is landed via GitHub native MERGE (e.g. `gh pr merge`, or the auto_merge actuator at .github/workflows/auto_merge.yml:139 `bin/ax merge "$PR_NUM" --apply`), but no step mints or appends a subject-continuity certificate to the side-ref ledger (refs/heads/axiom/certificates) after landing. Additionally, the Verdict B migration (commit 35665483a) removed the `ax merge subject` issuance entry point from merge_cli (recordSubjectClaim deleted; current merge_cli.nim only dispatches --dry-run/--apply), so there is currently no CLI path to persist a new verification subject — the attestation chain (cert_cli resolveStoredSubjectByHeadSha, subject_store) can only load pre-existing stored subjects. Consequence: every native merge landing leaves the ledger's latest certificate attesting to an older main tip, so the merge-continuity workflow (.github/workflows/merge_continuity.yml, `ax cert continuity` → continuity_check.nim) fails with CC_MISMATCH — observed 5+ times in CI runs 34482418249, 34487756804, 34494192912, 34553554559, 34572757522, the last on 2026-09-11 for PR #65 landing 433c505c6d2fc2f163901affaa6e287f982ae8e9. Required end-state fix: every canonical main state transition must have a deterministic certificate transition, covering native GitHub merge landing paths as well — NOT merely "add append to ax merge --apply". UPDATE 2026-09-12: certificate-transition coupling implemented for the actuator path — F10 (certificate as admission input, Pass 2.96 live, commit 2a6b229cf) + F8 (fresh-subject production path: verify-candidate evidence artifact → attest.yml fail-closed binding verification → subject-register → attest → ledger append, commit b7868180c; Phase B verdict docs/audit/authority_artifact_minimization_2026-09-12.md Branch (i)). Stays open until production-path E2E evidence (mergeGo → native MERGE → continuity ccPassed) is recorded. CLOSURE 2026-10-07 (debt-truth reconciliation, close condition met — evidence writeback): the required production-path E2E evidence IS recorded — docs/evidence/certified_landing_mint_path_2026-09-18.md (the designated 기록지 for this closure) and the DEBT#464 entry record the full chain on PR #118: candidate H²=0f7c2ce1916c admission run 35247982673, ledger append tip a8f903528383 recorded BEFORE native MERGE, landing H=7295b2224656 with parent1(H)==H¹, canonical-main run 35250462037 (event=push) bind/continuity/accept all success with '[cert] Continuity: ccPassed' and accept R(7295b2224656) at canonical-acceptances tip eac8cdee9f95 — mergeGo → native MERGE → continuity ccPassed, exactly the recorded-evidence condition stated above. The certificate-transition coupling prerequisites were landed earlier (F10 2a6b229cf, F8 b7868180c).
entries.resolutionNote: Close condition met with recorded production-path E2E evidence (mergeGo → native MERGE → continuity ccPassed on PR #118: admission run 35247982673, pre-merge ledger append tip a8f903528383, landing H=7295b2224656 parent1(H)==H¹, canonical-main run 35250462037 bind/continuity/accept all success, '[cert] Continuity: ccPassed', accept at canonical-acceptances tip eac8cdee9f95) — evidence doc docs/evidence/certified_landing_mint_path_2026-09-18.md (verified present on origin/main 4805fe1df) plus the DEBT#464 entry's E2E record; coupling implementation F10 (2a6b229cf) + F8 (b7868180c) already landed 2026-09-12. Evidence writeback from the DEBT#464 record; no code change in this reconciliation.

entries.description: The pre-merge certificate mint ceremony (subject-register → attest → ledger-append) has no automated producer in CI. Clean-slate commit fa069d610 deleted attest.yml, verify-candidate and auto_merge.yml — the three workflows that carried the automated mint chain (attest.yml was mint-only contents:read; auto_merge.yml was the sole contents:write holder performing post-verdict ledger-append). The only living mint path is the ADR-0021 §D9 operator procedure executed manually per candidate PR: bin/ax cert subject-register → bin/ax cert attest (Ed25519 deterministic seed key, kernel re-run stages a–g via the attestation orchestrator) → bin/ax cert ledger-append (GitHub REST git-data FF PATCH force=false). First E2E observation closing DEBT#462: PR #118 candidate H²=0f7c2ce1916c107e683163eb67bca3081d8db7fc, admission run 35247982673 (check_suite 95462852362, attempt 1), ledger append tip a8f903528383db63615a41fe366d0b42d2f2b432 recorded BEFORE native MERGE (pre-merge gate: main==H¹=bd26bdbb7605cba4344fce4e3802028cdecbc9d3), landing H=7295b22246562e0b6062a52d62266a5c68204c22 with parent1(H)==H¹, canonical-main run 35250462037 (event=push) bind/continuity/accept all success (continuity log: 'bound cert: headSha==parent2', '[cert] Continuity: ccPassed'; accept log: R(7295b2224656) at canonical-acceptances tip eac8cdee9f95f9c1344413b42973904bc7ef8192). Consequence: every future candidate PR requires a human-run mint ceremony; a forgotten or mistimed mint fail-closes canonical continuity (CC_NO_CERT path, as observed on landing bd26bdbb7), so certified landing depends on operator memory rather than CI enforcement. Fix direction (NOT implemented): reintroduce an automated mint producer in the admission/canonical authority model without resurrecting obsolete auto_merge/dispatch authority — e.g. a workflow-runs admission-producer-triggered mint job (contents:write scoped, FF-CAS ledger append, identical kernel stages a–g via bin/ax cert attest), keeping single-writer ledger semantics. Evidence doc: docs/evidence/certified_landing_mint_path_2026-09-18.md. CLOSURE 2026-10-07 (debt-truth reconciliation, EXTINCT — the named fix direction is implemented and supersedes the manual-only path): the automated mint producer now exists in the admission/canonical authority model on origin/main 4805fe1df — .github/workflows/admission-check.yml:949-963 runs `bin/ax cert subject-register` automated and fail-closed (REG_EXIT != 0 → step exit 1; no GITHUB_TOKEN — subject-register performs NO network), .github/workflows/certificate-mint.yml prepare verifies the unsigned witness with the B-built trusted bin/ax and signs via `bin/ax cert attest --sign` (:811, kernel stages re-run by the attestation orchestrator), and its publish job is the single contents:WRITE holder performing FF-CAS reconciliation with `bin/ax cert ledger-append` (:1495) under D6 exactly-once idempotency — matching the entry's own fix direction (contents:write-scoped, FF-CAS ledger append, identical kernel stages, single-writer ledger semantics). The human-run mint ceremony is no longer the only living mint path, so the registered consequence ('certified landing depends on operator memory') no longer holds.
entries.resolutionNote: EXTINCT — the entry's named fix direction (automated admission-producer-triggered mint producer: contents:write-scoped, FF-CAS ledger append, identical kernel stages a–g) is implemented on origin/main 4805fe1df: subject-register automated + fail-closed in admission-check.yml:949-963; attest --sign of the B-verified witness in certificate-mint.yml prepare (:811); FF-CAS exactly-once ledger-append in the single contents:WRITE publish job (:1495). Verified by direct inspection of the current workflows; the manual ADR-0021 §D9 procedure remains as fallback, not as the only path.

entries.description: IR obligation-lowering regression introduced by commit 4b55dec1e40744354e9d7770c8b4de877b1a4391 (feat(verification): semantic fact preservation + evidence ladder, ACT2 WP4-j.2~j.4): obligations whose lowering requires body-binding lost their body binding, so symbols depending on body-bound IR — safeSpeedupRatioCore, proximityScore — fall back to psFail in the proof pipeline. 2026-10-07 evidence enrichment: the regression also affects normalizeMaxWorkers and calcDynamicTimeoutCore — all four Axiom-internal kernel obligations (normalizeMaxWorkers, calcDynamicTimeoutCore, safeSpeedupRatioCore, proximityScore) re-prove psFail with provenance pkNone (Z3 SAT) on every `ax prove` run with an external subject. Pre-regression certificate preserved in data/archive/src/core/orchestrator/092c603556d3ad08fd42e3e198cc9701f5e612479bc498c09379adaf5a8400e7.json: normalizeMaxWorkers certZ3Verified (ir-bmc-z3-unsat) at irHash 092c603556d3…; the current failing run's build/certificates/manifest.json entry carries the IDENTICAL irHash with status certRed — same IR proved UNSAT before 4b55dec1e and now SAT. Registered finding only; fix deferred. Confirmed non-blocking for merge admission: identical psFail pattern was observed in PR #114's admission run 35128877634 which passed all required checks, and the current admission contract (workflowId 359582573, required 5 checks) does not gate on these two obligations. Recovery path: restore body-binding for the affected IR obligations (evidence-ladder lowering in src/verification) or explicitly classify them as evidence-ladder-degraded in the obligation schema, so psFail is a tracked degradation instead of a silent semantic loss. Tracked in docs/evidence/certified_landing_mint_path_2026-09-18.md §추적 부채; mechanically non-fatal for the certified landing chain (continuity/accept unaffected).
entries.resolutionNote: FIXED — typed obligation lowering의 result 0-ary declare-fun 상수화(psFail 회귀)를 본문 바인딩으로 복원. (1) src/core/trusted/private/obligation_smt_lowering.nim: SmtLoweringContext에 funcDef: Option[IRFuncDef] 추가; planImplBinding이 (define-fun <name>_impl (params) ret <body>) + (assert (let ((result (<name>_impl params))) (not <query>))) 형태를 플랜하고, 본문이 typed define-fun impl 슬라이스 밖이면 refuse(fail-closed) — 기존 classic irToSmtScript 폴백을 보존. result는 let-bound(declaredVars 제외), 파라미터는 선언 유니버스에 병합·정렬·dedup, fact의 result 참조와 파라미터 정렬 불일치는 거부. funcDef 미전달 시 기존 동작 불변(골든 스크립트 불변). (2) src/verification/batch_uap/ir_pipeline_runner.nim: loweringCtx에 funcDef: some(funcDef) 전달 + C20 BMC VerificationModel 판정 결합. (3) boRem 삼자 일치(ast_to_ir/canonical_verification/proofs/IR/Denotation.lean)는 본 슬라이스 동반 변경. MEASURED 2026-10-07 (branch fix/semantic-generation-body-binding): ax prove --target normalizeMaxWorkers — 과거 전체 기록(2026-09-17~2026-10-05, logs/ax_prove_trajectory.jsonl)이 no_obligation/plkL2Pdr로 의무 생성 자체가 없던 것과 달리, 본 실행에서 의무가 생성되어 define-fun impl 스크립트로 solverStatus=unsat 복귀 (서명 저널 data/trusted/journal/f50ac54ed0749190f82aa43387e8517dca3aec4a2bf3a76fffe1a17eaf24ccdb.json, z3Executed=true, solverInputDigest=sha256:88c3a144f7f5318db391ee55d0f60fd43ec75b38f80103ff7405e576951a4210, 스크립트 전문 첨부: docs/evidence/debt465_c20_borem_slice_2026-10-07.md). 잔여: Lean 커널 체크(생성 소스 <string>(54,3) invalid indentation)로 cert가 certZ3Candidate에 머무름 — 본 슬라이스 변경은 순수 추가형(boRem 분기)이라 rem 미사용 함수의 생성 소스는 바뀌지 않으며, 승급 게이트는 후속 슬라이스 과제. 나머지 3종(calcDynamicTimeoutCore/safeSpeedupRatioCore/proximityScore)은 회귀 전 수준 유지(09-17 calcDynamicTimeoutCore 실측 unsat 기록 존재). 2026-10-08 attribution addendum (branch fix/lean-emit-indentation): the `<string>(54,3) Error: invalid indentation` line quoted in the 2026-10-07 evidence is NOT a Lean kernel diagnostic — it is the Nim parser (src/core/parser_utils.nim parseStringAST, fakePath "<string>") rejecting tools/ci/add_raises_annotations.nim's empty multiline table constructor (`PostProcess = {` + newline + `  }.toTable`), reproduced verbatim with nim 2.2.10 `nim check` and fixed in the same file as a compile-valid one-line const (default(Table[string, Table[string, string]]) + .pairs iteration; quirk doc docs/spec/nim_empty_multiline_table_constructor_quirk.md). The genuine Lean-emission defect blocking the kernel check on the generated module (irToLeanModule fallthrough path) was the bare-numeral projection `0.toInt`/`1.toInt` (lean 4.33.0: "unexpected identifier after decimal point"; `(0).toInt` also fails — Nat has no toInt). Fixed deterministically by the single ascribed-projection rule `(op : BitVec 64).toInt` (leanBvSignedProj) applied at every comparison emission site in src/core/trusted/ir_to_lean.nim. Residual: normalizeMaxWorkers still lands certZ3Candidate because the canonical I6 path fails pre-kernel for the live pipeline funcDef (no kernel-check dump emitted; runner discards the canonical result silently) — the promotion blocker is upstream of the Lean emission and stays a tracked follow-up. The canonical I6 render for the engine-shaped funcDef was measured kernel-clean (exit 0, 271 bytes) on pinned lean 4.33.0. 2026-10-09 attribution addendum (branch fix/witness-pin-and-kernel-promotion): the silent canonical-I6 discard quoted above was exposed first — ir_pipeline_runner now logs [canonical-declined] with evidence+sealError instead of discarding — and its first cause was fixed: the §2.1a selection boundary measured parse-bound components from RuntimeAxiomEntry.sourceContent, which registry entries intentionally do NOT carry ('not carried' per the RuntimeAxiomEntry contract), and the documented path-relative fallback was missing, so every internal subject sealed with 'module source bytes unavailable'. Fixed in selectProofCandidates (ir_pipeline_runner.nim): entries with empty sourceContent resolve their bytes from sourcePath via findRepoRoot and carry them into the worker-chain binding site (buildSubjectBinding). Re-measured (bin/ax prove, this branch): the sealError now names the real next layer per subject — normalizeMaxWorkers/safeSpeedupRatioCore: EA_UNSUPPORTED ckIfStmt outside the certified-subset wire set; proximityScore: EA_REFERENCE_ERROR (ircheck binary not built — resolved by lake build ircheck), then completenessRecordDigest unmeasurable (external materializer must run before canonical verification). Residual blockers are design boundaries, not silent failures: the ckIfStmt wire-set extension requires Lean extractor recertification (§0.9b), and the canonical contract 'no bound id ⇒ no verified certificate is possible' (canonical_verification.nim) keeps the Z3-unsat fallback leg (runLeanVerification) at certZ3Candidate even though its negative-mutation check now passes — the ':=\nby' emission shape (irFuncDefToTheorem) was unbuildable by the ':= by'-only anchor in lean_evidence/lean_lsp_compiler, producing the VACUOUS misfire from the 2026-10-08 addendum; fixed by the whitespace-tolerant anchor and measured VACUOUS-free with certZ3Candidate retained in the same runs (tests/unit/test_lean_evidence.nim covers both emission forms). certGreen promotion for these obligations is a tracked follow-up, not this slice.

entries.title: 미실행 Work Unit 격자 (W1·W3–W7·W9–W11) — release full L2 운영 재정의: 현행 CI 9-job (ADR-0024 release-boundary authority, 결정 #15 — A1.3 supersede)
entries.description:
ADR-0017·ADR-0019·tiers 스펙의 full L2 계약('모든 Work Unit(W1–W11 + W9) 실행') 대비, 현행 CI(CI=0 cutover 이후 유일한 실행 인프라 .github/workflows/runner-pool-acceptance.yml)는 ci-bootstrap + gateway-shard×8 + gateway-identity-gate = 9 jobs만 실행하며 그 외 격자 W1·W3–W7·W9–W11은 실행되지 않는다. 사용자 확정 결정(2026-09-23)으로 'release tag full L2 = 현행 CI 전체 실행 9 jobs'로 운영 재정의(ADR-0024 결정 #15 — ADR-0017 Amendment A1.3을 supersede)하며, 미실행 격자를 본 DEBT로 명시적 등재해 full-L2 격자 강행 주장(M4 theater)을 차단한다. W2(ci-bootstrap)·W8(test-gateway)는 9-job에 근사 대응하나 계약상 격자 실행이 아니다. 등재·Amendment로 허위 주장이 아니며, 격자 실행은 미래 CI 플랫폼에서의 설계 계약으로 유지된다. Cross-ref: ADR-0024(결정 #15 — A1.3 supersede), .github/workflows/runner-pool-acceptance.yml(release-ship workflow_call 위임 — v* tag push 트리거는 2026-09-26 제거, ADR-0024), src/gate/proof_unit_catalog.nim(W SSOT).

(b+ 2026-09-30 개정 — Known-branch witness 기록, epoch-cutover-oracle-select-pr-b): 현행 9-job CI가 제공하는 검증 witness는 known branch(착지 candidate admission · release 출하 경로)에 한정되며, 격자 프로젝션 밖 W4 클래스(컨테이너 W4 및 서브유닛 G1/G2/G6/G7)의 실행·witness는 현재 미실현이다. 이 개정은 W4가 DEBT#466 본문의 미실행 범위(W1·W3–W7·W9–W11)에 이미 포함됨을 Known-branch witness 관점에서 재확인·명시하며, 격자 실행 주장(M4 theater) 차단을 유지한다. cross-ref: docs/spec/incremental_ci_tiers_scheduling.md Amendment(2026-09-30), ADR-0019(2026-09-30 Status), DEBT#469.
entries.resolution: UNRESOLVED deferred 2026-09-23 (explicit user decision, ADR-0017 Amendment A1): release full L2는 현행 CI 9-job 운영 재정의로 유지하고(ADR-0024 결정 #15 전환 후에도 release-ship → runner-pool force_full 위임), 미실행 격자 W1·W3–W7·W9–W11 실행은 미래 CI 플랫폼 채택 시 해소(설계 계약 유지). entries.title: selector(impact_closure_selector.nim) 자체는 런타임 후보-트리 빌드 — B-pin 잔존 신뢰 경계 (3-PR 오라클 계획 범위 밖)
entries.description: tools/ci/impact_closure_selector.nim은 select job에서 런타임에 후보 트리(candidate checkout)로부터 컴파일되어 decision envelope을 산출한다. config/trusted_writer_set.json의 trustedCheckerTreeClosure는 소스 blob을 B-pin하나(tools/ci/impact_closure_selector.nim sha cc85db420…, ci/checker.mk cef1df55… 등 — ADR-0025 §6), 빌드 산출물(binary) 자체의 생성 주체는 후보 트리이며, '오라클·게이트 바이너리를 B(base sha) 전체 trusted tree에서 컴파일'하는 3-PR 계획(PR-B/C)에서 selector 자체의 B-pin은 명시적 범위 밖으로 유보된다. 이 유보 = 잔존 신뢰 경계이며 fail-open 아님: 주장(claim)은 'selector 결정이 엔진 권위를 갖는다'가 아니라 'selector는 결정 보조(decision envelope, oracleEvidence 소비·검증만)'임을 한정한다(셀프-파생 금지 — selector는 derivedEmpty를 도출하지 않고 검증만). cross-ref: docs/adr/0025-gateway-landing-authority.md Amendment C(2026-09-30) §(6), tools/ci/impact_closure_selector.nim:1414(landingFloor, 병렬 편집 중 라인 이동 가능), docs/evidence/epoch_record_oracle_select_2026-09-30.md.
entries.resolution: UNRESOLVED deferred 2026-09-30 (PR-B epoch cutover 문서 트랙 — 3-PR 계획 명시적 범위 밖): selector B-pin(오라클·게이트 바이너리 B-tree 컴파일)은 후속 PR 소관. Implementation site가 tools/(런타임 빌드)이라 open=>source-marker contract는 적용 불가 — marker deferred. NOT satisfied, NOT resolved — 열린 정책 항목.

entries.title: L0 '영향 폐쇄가 공집합이어도 L0은 항상 실행' 문장이 현행 CI와 불일치 — DEBT#466 미실현과 연동된 계약-실행 간극
entries.description: docs/spec/incremental_ci_tiers_scheduling.md:25·:28('영향 폐쇄가 공집합이더라도 실행되어야 한다(정적 검증은 항상 유효)') 및 ADR-0019:25·:66·:92의 'L0는 항상 실행' 문장은 격자 모델의 계약(설계)이다. 그러나 현행 CI(CI=0 cutover 이후 유일 실행 인프라 .github/workflows/runner-pool-acceptance.yml, 9-job)는 L0 격자(W3·W4/G7·W10·W11)를 별도 실행하지 않으며 DEBT#466(2026-09-23)으로 '미실현'이 공식 등재되어 있다. 본 DEBT는 두 문장이 계약(설계)과 현행 CI(실행) 사이의 불일치 상태임을 명시적으로 기록한다 — 문장의 삭제·재해석이 아니라 '미실현' 사실의 병존 기록. cross-ref: docs/spec/incremental_ci_tiers_scheduling.md:25,:28(:166-168 §6.3 L0 연계), docs/spec/incremental_ci_tiers_scheduling.md Amendment(2026-09-30), ADR-0019(2026-09-30 Status), DEBT#466, docs/evidence/epoch_record_oracle_select_2026-09-30.md.
entries.resolution: UNRESOLVED deferred 2026-09-30 (DEBT#466과 동일 근거 — 격자 실행은 미래 CI 플랫폼의 설계 계약으로 유지): L0 격자 실행 미실현이 계약 문장과 병존함을 기록만. Implementation site가 src/ 밖(설계 계약·CI 워크플로)이라 open=>source-marker contract는 적용 불가 — marker deferred. NOT satisfied, NOT resolved — 열린 정책 항목.

entries.title: sandbox_launcher feature test asserts only compile-time tautologies (check true density 100%)
entries.description: tests/gateway/sandbox_launcher_feature_test.nim held two unittest cases, both unfailable: `check moduleSrc.len > 0` asserted a `{.strdefine.}` compile-time string literal (the test never imported or compiled the module under test, it only compared a string constant against 0), and `check defaultTimeout == 120` compared a local `const defaultTimeout = 120` with itself. Neither case could ever fail, so the suite reported green coverage for src/infrastructure/gate_signing/sandbox_launcher.nim without executing a single line of it; the launcher itself had zero importers repo-wide. Its Gherkin spec tests/features/sandbox_launcher.feature asserted real sandbox behavior that no implementation backed, so it was removed with the layer rather than left as an uncovered spec. Registered per AGENTS.md §0.9 before removal.
entries.resolutionNote: Vacuous test and its orphaned launcher deleted together; zero live importers confirmed by repo-wide grep (no .nim import site, no .nims/config reference). contentHash is the pre-deletion sha256 of the test artifact, so AGENTS.md §0.9a file+symbol+contentHash skip matching resolves against the exact audited content.

entries.title: AXIOM_RECURSION_GUARD — unsigned ambient env var acted as a gate-skip authority at five call sites (`if verifyInternalBypass(): quit(0)`)
entries.description: verifyInternalBypass*() (src/core/trusted/env_access.nim:33-35) evaluated `getAxiomEnv(evRecursionGuard) == "1"` — an unsigned, unauthenticated, ambient environment variable was the sole input to a boolean that five gate entry points used to terminate with exit code 0: runHookPreCommit (src/gate/gateway.nim:513), runHookPrepareCommitMsg (:695), runHookCommitMsg (:810), runHookPrePush (:858), and the gate_hook main-module stage dispatcher (src/gate/runners/gate_hook.nim:108). Any process able to set AXIOM_RECURSION_GUARD=1 in its environment silenced every gate while producing no receipt, no audit entry, and no binding to the staged tree. The gateway itself armed the authority with a bare putEnv("AXIOM_RECURSION_GUARD", "1") immediately before `git commit --no-verify` (src/gate/gateway.nim:444), so the skip was ambient rather than scoped, and gateway.nim:454 disarmed it only on the `contextToken.len > 0` branch. The stated purpose (do not re-run gates for a tree the gateway already validated) is already served fail-closed by a different, live mechanism that this change leaves untouched: the five-condition AXIOM_GATE_CONTEXT_ID + .axiom/gate_receipt.json predicate in src/gate/runners/gate_hook.nim:203-248 (token present; token == current `git write-tree`; receipt exists and parses as JSON; receipt.treeHash == token; receipt.failedCount == 0), with the receipt written atomically via src/gate/attestation.nim. Deletion therefore removes an authority without removing a capability. No HMAC, signing, or issuer mechanism was introduced — HMAC commit signing was deleted 2026-09-29 as a GitHub-native duplicate (tools/ci/doc_reference_policy.json:54), and ADR-0025 §2/§7 forbid adding trust structure.

In src/gate/static_gate_scanner.nim the `let contentHash = computeContentHash(content)` / `discard contentHash` pair was removed rather than implemented — it was pure dead computation with no consumer, so implementing change tracking would have been new functionality outside this debt's scope. entries.title: src/gate/predicates/base.nim:195 verifyHmacSignaturePresent — substring match presented as HMAC verification, pinned by a test
entries.description: verifyHmacSignaturePresent*(payload) returned `"hmac_sha256:" in payload or "AXIOM_HMAC" in payload`. No key, no MAC computation, no verification of any kind — the doc comment claimed 'HMAC-SHA256 signature marker'. Its only in-source consumer was checkBypassTokenValid* (src/gate/predicates/base.nim:276), which fed runBypassTokenGate* (src/gate/handlers/security_handlers.nim:48) and a standalone CLI branch (`security_handlers bypass <payload>`, :228) that printed 'bypass token valid' and quit(0). tests/test_gate_matrix.nim:357 asserted the theater as correct behaviour: `check runBypassTokenGate("hmac_sha256:deadbeef") == true  # valid signature present`. HMAC commit signing was removed on 2026-09-29 as a GitHub-native duplicate (tools/ci/doc_reference_policy.json:54; ADR-0025 Amendment B), yet this predicate and its test remained — a cryptographic claim that enforced nothing.
entries.resolution: FIXED 2026-10-04: verifyHmacSignaturePresent* and its sole consumer checkBypassTokenValid* deleted from src/gate/predicates/base.nim; runBypassTokenGate* and the `of "bypass":` CLI branch deleted from src/gate/handlers/security_handlers.nim; the two tests pinning the theater removed from tests/test_gate_matrix.nim. No replacement mechanism was introduced — ADR-0025 §7 forbids adding a signature scheme, issuer, signer or env var, and ADR-0025 Amendment B records the 2026-09-29 HMAC deletion. What remains: src/core/trusted/bypass_verify.nim (Ed25519, verify-only, TOTP-windowed) is the sole emergency-bypass authority and was neither touched nor duplicated. src/gate/handlers/security_handlers.nim itself survives with its other 9 handlers (auth, audit, permission, exception-safety, import-boundary, LFS-pointer, manifest-sync, state-hash, theater-detection); it is imported only by tests/test_gate_matrix.nim and is not a registered gate in src/gate/topology_spec.nim, config/gates.json or src/gate/manifest.d/, so no registration change was required.

entries.title: AXIOM_GATE_SEVERITY / AXIOM_REBASELINE ambient env downgrades gate verdicts to PASS, and the orchestrator cannot observe it
entries.description: A gate's verdict meaning was settable by any ambient environment variable, with no CLI flag and no audit trail. Measured on the import-encapsulation-gate runner against a fixture with exactly one violation: AXIOM_GATE_SEVERITY=warn -> exit 0 and '[GUARD:WARN] 1 import encapsulation violations'; unset -> exit 1 and '[GUARD] 1 import encapsulation violations'; AXIOM_GATE_SEVERITY=error -> exit 1. The warn branch is src/gate/runners/import_encapsulation_gate.nim:110-114, which sets ok:true on a declared-svError gate. The orchestrator cannot see the difference: src/gate/orchestrator/hook/executor.nim:216 reduces the child to GateResult(ok: exitCode == 0, ...) and src/gate/orchestrator/hook/executor.nim:1146-1155 discards the child's stdout on success, so the marker '[GUARD:WARN]' never reaches any caller. AXIOM_REBASELINE is the second instance of the same defect class: src/gate/orchestrator/hook/executor.nim:186-187 injects --update-baseline into every gate's argv from that ambient var, and several gates then rewrite their baseline and return 0.

entries.resolution: FIXED 2026-10-07 — ambient authority removed at the reader; supersedes the 2026-10-04 parent-side scrub recorded in the previous PARTIALLY FIXED note. (1) Severity: both AXIOM_GATE_SEVERITY readers deleted from the §-1-immutable src/gate/runners/import_encapsulation_gate.nim (pre-closure :137/:230); the scan procs take the manifest-declared severity only (default 'error'), so the warn-only ok:true branch is unreachable on every path. effect_inference_gate.nim:151 reader deleted with the same shape (default 'warn' retained; WarningViolated still exits 1). (2) Rebaseline: putEnv('AXIOM_REBASELINE') transport deleted (gateway.nim:532, gate_hook.nim:166); the sanctioned --rebaseline flag is threaded as an explicit updateBaseline: bool parameter gateway/gate_hook → runSingleGateIfRequested / runPreCommit / runPrePush / runCi → runAllGatesParallel → L2GateWorkerCtx / dispatchGate → runSingleGateImpl, which appends --update-baseline to gate argv from the parameter (executor.nim env read deleted). Sanctioned capability preserved end-to-end; ambient transport gone. (3) AXIOM_UPDATE_BASELINE measured as a single-factor env read with NO interlock (baseline_manager.nim isUpdateMode), shadowing asset_hygiene_gate's existing explicit --update-baseline argv path: env reader + updateBaselineFromCurrent + atomicWriteBaseline deleted and core/gate/baseline_manager.nim removed whole (zero importers after the edit) — atomic deletion, no dead scrub (§0.9a). coverage_ratchet_gate.nim's env-only rewrite branch (no explicit counterpart existed) removed with the module. (4) EnvVar enum members evGateSeverity / evUpdateBaseline / evRebaseline deleted (DEBT#476 precedent); the 2026-10-04 delEnv scrub in bootstrapGateEnvironment deleted — a scrub guarding now-nonexistent readers would itself be dead theater. (5) Invariance test rewritten to binary-level injection with no bootstrap involved: the runner binary runs under AXIOM_GATE_SEVERITY=warn / unset / error injected directly and must show an identical verdict and count (exit 1, [GUARD] 1) across all three. (6) docs/spec/environment_inputs.md: three DECLARED rows removed and the Principle tightened — no unaudited ambient input may influence a gate verdict on any path; verdicts are shaped only by declared, audited surfaces. Stale pointer cleaned: nim_effect_system_quirks.md §18 rewriteGateSeverity template (deleted code); docs/agents/architecture.md:327 TRM narrative retained as history. Memo-cache hole from the PARTIALLY FIXED note: eliminated by reader deletion, NOT by gate_contract.nim rework — with zero verdict-shaping env readers, envDependencies: [] is sound, so the architect-locked file was not touched. contentHash rebound to the post-closure bootstrapGateEnvironment body (extractProcText sha256; see lineRange note). entries.title: tools/decision_binding_checker.nim TOML fallback parsed every key as the file path, yielding zero exemptions and exit 0
entries.description: parseTOMLValue returned the value after '=' for any key, so `reason = "..."` and `expires = "..."` both overwrote currentFile and the branch that would have read expires was unreachable. The fallback emitted 23 entries whose filePath was the literal string "2026-12-31" — zero real exemptions. Because entries.len != 0, the expiry check parsed an empty string, swallowed the exception, kept anyExpiringSoon false, and the tool exited 0 with ~229 unmasked violations. It fires exactly when config/decision_binding.waiver.json — the declared runtime canonical — is absent, so the authority-missing condition returned a green build. Separately, tools/hermetic_build.nim nested the JSON load inside `if fileExists(<toml>):` and never populated waiverEntries from JSON, so the TOML was the sole supplier of the token separating WARN from FAIL at :1758-1760.
entries.resolution: FIXED 2026-10-04: TOML fallback deleted; a missing, unreadable or unparsable waiver.json is now a hard fail-closed exit(1) checked before the audit branch so audit mode cannot mask a missing authority. hermetic_build's JSON block hoisted out of the TOML guard and made to populate waiverEntries with reason+expires, mirroring the TOML sites. Measured after: checker --audit-mode still 24 violations with a diff-identical list; hermetic_build --check-decision-bindings still 32 violations, WARN, exit 0. The TOML's canonical-vs-generated role is deliberately NOT decided here — an architect proposal is open on that.

entries.title: Makefile:527-531 verify-contract fanout races on the shared build/nimcache — the canonical contract-preservation entrypoint fails nondeterministically
entries.description: `verify-contract` starts its four subtargets with `&` and joins them with `wait` (Makefile:527-531). They share `build/nimcache`, and the hermetic build in one of them executes 'Clearing build/nimcache for deterministic clean builds', deleting the object files the others are still writing. Observed failure modes, all on merged main 8d3c9795: gcc 'can't create .../@pverification@...nim.c.o: No such file or directory'; ld 'cannot find .../@pcore@...nim.c.o'; and at run time 'cannot open: .../build/nimcache/verify-contract-release-e2e/ax.json [IOError]'. A failed run also leaves `bin/ax` missing, which then fails `verify-contract-unit` and `verify-scenario-oracles` with '[Integrity Violation] bin/ax is missing'. All four subtargets pass when run serially (g1 exit 0 with M1/M2/M3 mutants killed; g2 exit 0; g6g4 exit 0; g7 exit 0), so the product is sound and the orchestration is not. This is pre-existing and independent of the authority-identity-binding workstream, which changed only config/repository_surface.json. [CLOSED 2026-10-07: residual eliminated by extending the DEBT#457 Build-once → Freeze → Fan-out idiom to bin/ax — verify-contract-artifacts (Makefile:598-605) serially seeds release bin/ax with g7's exact flags (A-1 CAS-symlink-aware) BEFORE fan-out, and g7-consume (Makefile:805-809) skips its rebuild when bin/ax is fresh (CAS symlink, or no *.nim under src//config/ newer), so fan-out members have zero concurrent bin/ax writers and the tests/config.nims existence guard is deterministically satisfied by the serial seed. GNU make manual (Parallel-Disable): 'If a makefile accurately defines all dependency relationships, make can build goals in parallel correctly.' Measured: make verify-contract ×3 exit 0 (1× CAS-symlink path, 2× real-file path exercising serial seed + freshness skip), 4/4 subtargets PASS each run, zero race signatures (gcc/ld '.c.o' failures and '[Integrity Violation] bin/ax is missing' all absent). Real-file builds additionally require a coherent src/generated/build_env.nim (SourceCoherence) — refresh it after src edits (rm -f + rebuild); pre-existing contract, hit and resolved during this slice's own verification.]
entries.lineRange: Makefile:598-605 (serial release bin/ax seed in verify-contract-artifacts, DEBT#481), 654-657 (fan-out nimcache roots), 670-681 (contract_fanout macro + fan-out calls), 805-809 (g7-consume freshness skip — RESOLVED shared -o:bin/ax writer); tests/config.nims:8-12 (bin/ax existence guard, deterministically satisfied by the serial seed)

entries.title: Pass 2.96 admission predicate compares certified headSha but never certified baseSha — a subject-continuity certificate issued against a different base is admitted for the same head
entries.description: Two different match rules govern the same signed subject-continuity certificate. The ACTUATOR path loadLedgerCertFor (src/cli/merge_cli.nim:1336) selects a certificate by the (baseSha, headSha) PAIR (line 1363: `if bs != baseSha or hs != headSha: continue`). The ADMISSION PREDICATE Pass 2.96 (src/cli/merge_cli.nim:671-711) matches on headSha ALONE: line 1491 in collectCertificateContinuityFacts filters `if node["headSha"].getStr("") != headSha: continue`, and the predicate body checks only signatureOk, headSha, policyDigest and scopeDigest. INV-1 (docs/spec/certification_continuity_contract.md:232) defines the certified subject as the 6-tuple (baseSha, headSha, headTreeDigest, policyDigest, scopeDigest, evidenceDigest), so baseSha IS part of what was certified — but Pass 2.96 never compares it. The fact carries it on BOTH sides: CertificateContinuityFacts.baseSha (line 226) is populated from node["baseSha"] at line 1397, and VerificationRecord.baseSha (line 267) is populated from the PR record's base.sha at line 988 — no fact-loading change is needed, the pure predicate simply omits the comparison. MEASURED EVIDENCE (not hypothetical): the live ledger refs/heads/axiom/certificates at tip 54cfa19d94e2052150ae19f72679174be4cb6d18 holds 176 certificates; 3 heads carry certificates at more than one distinct base. The head cited in the audit, d528d353e37cf46711cd8dab008d8228db499d3d, carries exactly two: cert 02e7014ec374…aaa1810 certified at base 7baa8af3d5938a688b9da6b2528faafc119f1468 for PR 440 (createdAt 2026-10-02T09:46:01Z), and cert 8034b028adf…79b77be certified at base 600a10177a103abf24ffea1e3b0a58b6bfac833c for prNumber 0 (createdAt 2026-10-02T09:54:09Z). The other two are head 8eca9428 (bases 9c4164bb / a577fda3, PR 427 and PR 0) and head f7cb52f4 (bases ef50c94f / fc15b997, PR 429 and PR 0). EXECUTED PROOF (2026-10-04, this audit): a temporary probe case added to tests/cli/test_merge_cli.nim bound a certificate with baseSha 600a10177a103abf24ffea1e3b0a58b6bfac833c to an admission whose base was current-main; `MergeAdmissible` returned result=mergeGo reasonCode=GO. The probe was reverted and the tree left clean. The predicate is therefore not merely missing a check — it demonstrably admits a certificate certified against a different base.
entries.resolution: FIXED 2026-10-05 on fix/freshness-authoritative-anchor (architect-approved plan Phase 1). The patch specified below landed exactly as specified: an exact-equality baseSha check inserted after the existing headSha check in Pass 2.96 (src/cli/merge_cli.nim), returning reasonCode SUBJECT_MISMATCH — a code already in the family and in the dry-run exit contract, so no new vocabulary; the five pre-existing certFacts call sites were left pinning baseSha "current-main", so zero existing verdicts changed. It landed TOGETHER with the freshness-anchor re-anchoring (ADR-0027 P4), which is what makes the comparison exact rather than incidental: VerificationRecord.baseSha is no longer the lagging live PR API base.sha but the run's EVENT-FROZEN anchor (AXIOM_MAIN_SHA) — the same value the certificate is minted against — so `cert.baseSha == V.baseSha` now states exactly that loadLedgerCertFor's (baseSha, headSha) PAIR key will resolve the admitted certificate. A mis-paired certificate is therefore denied BEFORE the merge instead of surfacing as a post-merge continuity failure. VERIFICATION: tests/cli/test_merge_cli.nim 59/59 [OK], including the new 'Admission contract — ledger cert key alignment (base, head) PAIR' suite (certified base == anchor → GO; certified base != anchor → SUBJECT_MISMATCH; head drift still outranks the base check) and the new 'freshness anchor (event-frozen base)' suite; bin/ax builds clean. The blocking condition recorded below (a trust-surface edit needs architect approval) was satisfied by the approved Phase-1 plan, which names this repair as its side decision.

entries.title: Attestation executor-membership suite silently skips its whole P15 block — the checker was deleted, so the suite reports success while executing zero assertions
entries.description: tests/verification/test_attestation.nim:1065 binds memberChecker to tools/ci/verify_executor_membership.sh; the entire P15 block is guarded at :1075 by `if fileExists(memberChecker) and dirExists(fixRoot / "main" / "phase0"):`, and the else branch at :1110 calls skip("executor membership suite", ...). tools/ci/verify_executor_membership.sh no longer exists on disk — it was removed by the CI=0 cutover, commit ce92fc2d1 'chore: remove CI infrastructure (CI=0 cutover)'. A fileExists guard on the very artifact under test means the suite asserts SUCCESS whenever the artifact is missing: the mint trust boundary (ADR-0021 D7 / ADR-0025 Amendment B) is currently verified by zero assertions. SECOND-ORDER DEFECT (restoring the script alone does not make the suite green): config/executor_authority.json trusted[] (lines 64-70) holds six historical blobs — 65a3c58f, 4ddad89b, fdf64839, 5ed8e108, 31cd390d, eb48f902 — while the only live executor action definition, .github/actions/setup-axiom-toolchain/action.yml, hashes to e54121c5cdab512f9896aad0b125de298742a303 (git hash-object), which is NOT in the set. A checker restored against the current trusted set would therefore reject every live executor, i.e. un-skipping alone would convert a vacuous pass into a red suite.
entries.resolution: PARTIALLY FIXED 2026-10-07 on fix/debt484-attestation-silent-skip — the registered theater (suite reports SUCCESS while executing zero assertions) is eliminated for the test facet: the dead fileExists guard on the deleted checker and its silent skip() branch are removed, and the checker's documented contract is re-expressed as a pure in-suite predicate in tests/verification/test_attestation.nim (main-root-forced trusted-set read — no config argument, an untrusted PR head is unreachable; full-line `//` comment strip before JSON parse; verdict 0 = member / 1 = fail-closed denial naming the set / 2 = fail-closed configuration error). The P15 block now executes 13 fail-able assertions against the golden trust-state fixtures, which survived ce92fc2d1 (only the script was deleted): Phase 0 {E1} admission/denials, post-merge {E1,E2} transition, PR-head manipulation invariance (V-A'4), non-vacuity (the manipulated PR-head set itself admits the attacker blob), fixture presence ASSERTED as FAIL not skip (missing ≠ valid empty), and the verdict-2 fail-closed paths. Evidence: local run 'ALL ATTESTATION TESTS PASSED (237 checks, 0 skipped)' — before this change the same suite emitted '[SKIP] executor membership suite' and passed. CI-SIDE RESIDUAL REMAINS OPEN AND UNCHANGED: no live executor-membership enforcement exists anywhere (verified 2026-10-07: src/ has no TrustedExecutorSet implementation — merge_cli.nim lists config/executor_authority.json only as a TrustSurface path; no .github workflow performs the membership check), so the ordered fix named above still applies — (2) re-anchor config/executor_authority.json trusted[] to the live executor blobs first (architect-gated trust-surface change requiring manual merge), then (1) restore tools/ci/verify_executor_membership.sh. This entry therefore stays deferred for that residual; the suite now pins the fixture-encoded contract and does NOT claim a live enforcement path.

entries.title: config/policy/merge_admission.json claims freshness is never reimplemented by merge_cli, but merge_cli implements the base-freshness predicate (STALE_BASE / BASE_UNRECORDED)
entries.description: config/policy/merge_admission.json:4 (the policy `description` SSOT field) states verbatim: 'Freshness is delegated to GitHub strict_required_status_checks_policy — never reimplemented by merge_cli.' src/cli/merge_cli.nim:616-637 implements exactly such a predicate: 'Pass 0 — base freshness (the SINGLE freshness predicate)' denies with reasonCode BASE_UNRECORDED when V.baseSha is empty (line 622) and with STALE_BASE when V.baseSha != mainSha (line 629). The module header at merge_cli.nim:30-36 and the actuation site at :1161-1163 state the OPPOSITE contract — 'Axiom decides freshness at evaluation time; GitHub re-binds it at merge time ... Axiom decides, GitHub enforces', and 'A3 (baseSha == current main tip) is a PRE-FLIGHT observation, NOT an atomic freshness guarantee'. So a delegation was written into the admission policy SSOT without being implemented, while the implementing code documents itself as a deliberate Axiom-side decision. An auditor reading the policy alone concludes Axiom holds no freshness authority in the admission domain; an auditor reading the code concludes Axiom holds the deciding one. Both cannot be true.
entries.resolution: FIXED 2026-10-05 on fix/freshness-authoritative-anchor (architect-approved plan Phase 1). The registered contradiction is eliminated by the repair named in this entry — a policy-text correction, NOT a code deletion, as required: config/policy/merge_admission.json v1.10.0 drops the 'never reimplemented by merge_cli' clause and records the implemented split (Axiom's Pass 0 is a real Axiom decision input evaluating freshness at admission time; GitHub re-binds the same fact at merge time via strict_required_status_checks_policy + merge-queue invalidation — ADR-0027 P3/R2, P4). No fail-closed check was deleted; the predicate is unchanged in strength and its deny branches (BASE_UNRECORDED, STALE_BASE) are intact. v1.10.0 also records the consequence the correction exposes, rather than hiding it: on the MERGE-QUEUE path Pass 0 compares the queue's own authoritative base (merge_group.base_sha == parents(G)[0], measured 2026-10-04) against itself, so the Axiom-side freshness deny does not fire there — the deny remains live for a declared main != recorded anchor and for an unrecorded anchor, and the PR-path 'base moved during the run' case is covered by the workflow's identity re-derivation plus GitHub's strict required-check invalidation. This is a partial fix in one sense only, and the residual is named: whether Axiom should hold a freshness decision input at all on the queue path, where it cannot deny, is a product-contract question for the Phase-2 contract revision, not a defect in this entry. ID CORRECTION: the equivalence audit that produced this finding (docs/evidence/equivalence_audit_2026-10-04T014512Z.md) cites the Pass-0 'not equivalent — retained' conclusion under 'DEBT#484'; after the single-writer renumbering the registry's DEBT#484 is an unrelated attestation-skip entry, so that cross-reference now points here.

entries.title: passFilenames subprocess fallback feeds gates a literal '--stdin-files' argv token and the real file list on stdin that those gate binaries never read — scan runs on a nonexistent path and PASSes vacuously
entries.description: executor.nim runSingleGateImpl builds subprocess argv for passFilenames=true gates by appending the literal token '--stdin-files' (src/gate/orchestrator/hook/executor.nim:183-184) and then writes the changed-file list to the child's stdin (:191-196). Only quality_gate_runner.nim:115-119 implements that protocol. import_encapsulation_gate.nim:134-135 and binary_artifact_gate.nim:176-180 instead take every argv token from position 1/4 onward as a filename and never read stdin, so under subprocess dispatch the binary's file list is exactly ['--stdin-files'] — a path that does not exist — and the real violating filenames go to a stdin nobody drains. Measured 2026-10-07 against bin/import_encapsulation_gate with a fixture containing exactly one forbidden import (import core/bmc/bmc_runner): subprocess-fallback argv shape ('... import_encapsulation_gate $FIX test 1 --stdin-files', filename piped to stdin) -> exit 0, '[GUARD] All imports properly encapsulated.' (vacuous PASS); control with the real filename on argv -> exit 1 with the violation reported. So any fallback-path dispatch of these gates reports PASS while scanning nothing. Primary enforcement of import-encapsulation-gate is the in-process path (pipeline_orchestrator.nim:99 runImportEncapsulationInProcess), which does not go through this argv shape — the vacuous branch is the subprocess fallback (AXIOM_INPROCESS_DISPATCH=off per src/gate/utils/inprocess_dispatch.nim:17, and non-registered gates such as binary-artifact-gate, which has passFilenames=true at topology_spec.nim:60 and no in-process registration; binary_artifact_gate is same-class by code reading, unmeasured — binary not built in the closure worktree). Related observation recorded, not fixed: the in-process single-gate entry scan runs runImportEncapsulationInProcess over the ProjectMap and ignores the changed-file list (in_process_gates.nim:83-97); when the ProjectMap is empty (observed in the single-gate pre-commit entry during the DEBT#478 Phase 2 drill) it scans 0 files and PASSes. Discovered 2026-10-07 during the DEBT#478 ambient severity authority closure (Phase 2 negative drills, §0.9 out-of-scope find — registered, not silently patched).
